member.name: P:ArcGIS.Desktop.Internal.Sharing.Views.SharingPaneViewRes.WriteCIMSymbolsToWebLinkChartInfo
member.summary:
Looks up a localized string similar to When checked, symbols are converted to web symbols that can be rendered by all applications, including older clients.
When unchecked, some symbols are preserved as ArcGIS Pro symbols. Use this option if the web link chart will be used in client applications that support rendering ArcGIS Pro symbols.
Symbols for data layers are stored in the new web layers that are published when the web link chart is shared. Symbol changes made to existing web layers are stored in the web link chart..
